Hi imcool,

In my point of view SL depends on everyones trading charakter. For example i cant trade with too tight SL, but tighter one is giving realy good RRR and someone else cant trade with bigger SLs i called it "more room" because higher win% and accuracy by entry is than needed so i think the bes way is to set your SL in zone you feel pretty confident and is working for you you have to try tighter ones with better RRR and of course try the "more room" technique with smaller risk

and what you feel is better for you, works for you, thats what you have to follow and work on

For me personaly "more room" technique is working better, so i always set SL according to the HTF I can have trades with SL over 100 pips and iam really fine with that, lower down my risk so than doesnt matter how much pips i need risk is still the same with SL20 or 150 pips

the SL is simply on HTF swings

If you don't mind can I ask a few questions on your GU trade?

First of all, the bull momentum on the up leg in the chart seems stronger than the bear momentum on the down leg, there was also compression above which suggested that price might want to go higher to the top of CP. As such how did you know that the supply zone would hold?

Secondly, I noticed that your SL was in the middle of a supply zone and not above it. This is pretty unconventional so could you explain the rationale for placing it there? Thanks in advance!
